statement: The survivor is Morgan Hale, a male Evacuee-scenario character with Survivor profession and Str/Dex/Int/Per all 8
The game starts in evac shelter A-23 (basement start) on spring day 61 at 8:00 AM, the shelter being southeast of Trenton
The shelter basement bathroom sinks hold 20 soap bars, a scrub brush, a FEMA evacuation pamphlet, paper, a first aid kit box (21 items) and a gallon jug of bleach
The survivor carries a first aid kit box holding 21 items including 18 drugs
The survivor carries a matchbook with 20 matches
The smartphone has a flashlight app and 54 of 56 battery charge
The survivor carries a sealed plastic bottle with 2 units of clean water and has no food
Janette Sutherland, a Modern Archer NPC with a takedown recurve bow, is in the shelter and agreed to travel with the survivor after a persuade check
Janette has no spare equipment to give when asked to share
Janette's job is to find a corporate accounting book for her
The survivor wields a stick picked up outside the shelter, which is the only weapon
The shelter's south wall has a curtained window that was opened and used as the exit to the outside forest
Remaining work: find food, renewable water, a cooking container and long-term survival plans; an antibiotics request is unfinished

note: Reached the sink with soap and supplies and decided what to pick up
Picked up the kit box, soap bars and pamphlet from the sink
Flashlight app was on while exploring the dark basement
Asked Janette to share equipment and she had nothing to give
Talked with Janette as a follower and opened the cooperation options
Janette's job option was available and the survivor reported no luck
Checked inventory for food and water at the end of the chunk
